activation_scope: Recipe sample only; does not enroll an account, deploy a worker, or certify a 35-day campaign.

campaign_capacity.policy: Quality first: never repeat a consumed URL, synthesize nutrients, reuse copyrighted cookbook photos, or stage incomplete records to fill a quota. Twelve reviewed recipes supply two full five-recipe dates and at most two recipes on the third date before exhaustion, before account exclusions or provider failures. This is not a first-week or 35-day supply. The live NHLBI catalog has 54 URLs, not 175; even clearing every URL cannot fill the campaign.

editorial_review.meal_type: Eligible records have manually reviewed canonical categories, not an LLM inference. Unreviewed records use the existing requires_review sentinel.
editorial_review.difficulty: Publisher does not supply a difficulty grade. Preserve the existing URL-ingestion requires_review sentinel, which the mobile formatDifficulty helper renders as Not set; do not invent easy/moderate/hard.

preflight_evidence.scope: Read-only recipe pool only; no enrollment, staging, production database access, private media uploads, deployment or paid provider requests. Tests use isolated in-memory database fixtures, with worker database/session and owned-media writes explicitly prohibited during live preflight.
checks: live allowlisted NHLBI HTML with complete ingredients, directions and exact prep/cook durations
exact serving yield, portion and all five nutrients match primary PDF review
individual Commons file-page PD/CC0/CC BY 4.0/CC BY-SA 4.0 resolution
real photo visually reviewed, downloaded, decoded, normalized and resolution/byte limits checked
worker clean_payload and RecipeCandidateInput validation; photo credit derivation

focused_tests.result: 141 passed, 1 skipped (opt-in live test run separately)

preflight_evidence.limitation: A point-in-time recipe preflight is not a worker deployment, workout preflight or guarantee of future provider availability or a 175-unique-recipe supply.

excluded_sources.nhs: Not included. Terms snapshot, refresh and attribution requirements need separate review; no unrestricted reuse is assumed.
excluded_sources.legacy_nhlbi: The old healthy-eating host redirects to the current 54-result catalog. Cached old pages are not live recipe proof.

post_preflight_editorial_review.reason: White-sauce photograph materially misrepresents this tomato-sauce recipe. Initial 13-item live preflight is historical; the remaining 12 retain the same verified source evidence.

photo_research.finding: Policy permits most NHLBI content but explicitly excludes some third-party images; government hosting and absence of a credit are not asset-specific clearance. Current recipe pages contain no dish photo. Legacy healthy-eating host redirects to the recipe index.
photo_research.creator_credit: Ben Fink Photography (acknowledgments, printed page vi)
photo_research.decision: Never copy the cookbook photographs. Reviewed independent Commons file pages are revalidated at runtime. All substitutions are representative photographs, not exact recipe photographs; preparation differences are disclosed in metadata and candidate warnings.
photo_research.accepted_image_record: User-approved BROADENWITHVISIBLEPHOTOCREDITS: only public domain, CC0, CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0, as defined by content_media.PERMITTED_LICENSES. Curated records pin an individual Commons photo_page_url plus dish-specific depicts and relevance_review. New records also pin reviewed license and creator; changed file-page identity, creator or license fails closed. At runtime commons_photo resolves the exact asset and license; _image requires photo_url, matching asset_url, evidence source_url, license_url, creator, credit, permission_verified=true, evidence and reviewed_on. Attribution licenses also require title, exact license URL and modification notice. Credits and share-alike notices are retained for Main's visible-credit UI. Representative status, preparation differences and extra credits are retained. No AI-generated photos; misleading or misidentified images are rejected, regardless of their title.

nutrition_review.method: Recipe-specific cookbook pages labeled each serving provides or Per Serving, or a serving-size nutrition box, are independently reviewed against live HTML. Match recipe identity, yield, serving size and all five exact values; never divide again by yield or round less-than values to zero. Entries without a matching review remain blocked.
